items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Named CTEs (word_stats, top_500, synset_counts), clear aliases that match the original (word_id, top_synsetid), consistent indentation. The short table aliases (s, syn, w) are normal SQL style, the same as in the reference.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Each CTE does one job: per-word aggregates, a top-500 cut, then ROW_NUMBER to pick the top synset. The correlated subqueries are gone, no logic is duplicated, and there are no leftover debug lines or extra columns.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A single declarative query with no error paths. The only constants are the HAVING thresholds (>= 2) and LIMIT 500, both carried over from the original query; nothing is derived from the current data.

items.name: Semantically equivalent, not just equal on this data
items.name_zh: 语义等价而非仅在当前数据上相等
items.evidence: word_stats groups senses JOIN synsets by s.wordid and applies LIMIT 500 before joining words. If some senses.wordid has no row in words (no FK enforces this), an orphan id could take a top-500 slot and later be dropped, changing the output. The tie-breaks (COUNT DESC, synsetid ASC; wordid ASC) are kept.
